payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force double loop over all pairs (i, j), compute XOR, check membership in set, and count parity.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively iterates over the Cartesian product of the two arrays, which is a form of complete search. Among the given complete_search subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest generic exhaustive search category, though the implementation uses simple nested loops instead of recursive backtracking.
